Acceptance Criteria:
- The billing process must initiate within 1 hour of approval for Practitioner status.
- At least 95% of approved CSMs should successfully complete the payment process on their first attempt.
- Users should receive a confirmation of their certification activation within 30 minutes of payment completion.

Test Outline:
- Monitor the time taken from approval to billing initiation to ensure it does not exceed 1 hour.
- Track the success rate of payment transactions for approved CSMs to confirm it meets the 95% threshold.
- Verify that confirmation messages regarding certification activation are sent within the specified 30-minute timeframe.

Original User Story: As a CST, I want to pay an annual fee, so that my CST status is active.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a CST, I want to pay my annual fee promptly so that I can maintain my active CST status and continue to access exclusive resources and opportunities.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The payment process must be completed within 5 minutes for at least 95% of users.
- Users should receive a confirmation of their payment status within 1 minute of submission.
- The system should ensure that at least 99% of payments are processed successfully without errors.

Test Outline:
- Track the time taken for users to complete the payment process and verify that it does not exceed 5 minutes.
- Monitor the time taken to send confirmation messages after payment submission to ensure it meets the 1-minute requirement.
- Review payment processing logs to confirm that the success rate of transactions is at least 99%.

Original User Story: As a site administrator, I want to set the annual fees for members, Practitioners and Trainers, so that fees can be set without involving a programmer.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a site administrator, I want to independently configure the annual fees for members, practitioners, and trainers so that I can manage pricing efficiently without needing to rely on a programmer.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The fee-setting interface must allow administrators to update fees within 5 minutes, ensuring timely adjustments.
- Changes to the fees should be reflected in the system and visible to users within 1 minute of being saved.
- The system should provide a confirmation notification for at least 95% of fee updates to ensure clarity and accountability.

Test Outline:
- Measure the time taken for an administrator to update and save the annual fees to ensure it does not exceed 5 minutes.
- Verify that the updated fees are displayed to users within 1 minute after the changes are made.
- Conduct tests to confirm that confirmation notifications are sent for the majority of fee updates.

Original User Story: As a member, I want to receive a reminder and a link, so that I can renew my membership.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a member, I want to receive timely reminders along with a direct renewal link so that I can easily renew my membership before it expires and avoid any service interruptions.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Members should receive a renewal reminder at least 7 days prior to the membership expiration date.
- The reminder email must include a clickable link that directs members to the renewal page, with a success rate of ≥95% for link functionality.
- At least 80% of members should complete the renewal process within 48 hours of receiving the reminder.

Test Outline:
- Track the timing of reminder emails sent to ensure they are dispatched 7 days before expiration.
- Test the functionality of the renewal link in the email to confirm it directs users to the correct page.
- Analyze renewal completion rates within 48 hours post-reminder to verify that at least 80% of members renew their membership.

Original User Story: As a member, I want to have the system email me a new password or a password reminder since i have short-term memory problems.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a member, I want the system to email me a new password or a password reminder so that I can regain access to my account without unnecessary stress.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Users must receive a password reset email within 5 minutes of requesting it, ensuring timely access.
- The email should include clear instructions and a secure link that expires within 15 minutes to enhance security.
- At least 95% of users should successfully reset their password on the first attempt, as measured over a one-month period.

Test Outline:
- Track the time taken from the password reset request to the email delivery to ensure it meets the 5-minute requirement.
- Verify that the email contains the correct instructions and that the secure link functions properly within the specified time frame.
- Monitor the success rate of password resets to confirm that it meets or exceeds the 95% threshold.

Original User Story: As a trainer, I want to read information of relevance only to trainers, so that the Scrum Alliance can share information with me easily.

User Story:
As a trainer, I want to access information specifically tailored for trainers so that the Scrum Alliance can efficiently share relevant updates and resources with me.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The system must filter and display trainer-specific content with an accuracy rate of ≥95% based on user roles.
- Users should be able to access this information within 3 seconds of logging in to ensure timely updates.
- At least 90% of trainers should report satisfaction with the relevance of the information provided in a follow-up survey.

Test Outline:

- Measure the time taken to load trainer-specific content after login to confirm it meets the 3-second requirement.

Original User Story: As a site editor, I want to post information in a trainers-only section, so that only trainers see it.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to publish content in a dedicated trainers-only section so that only authorized trainers can access this information, ensuring confidentiality and relevance.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The trainers-only section must restrict access to 100% of users who are not designated as trainers.
- Content posted in this section should be visible to trainers within 5 seconds of publication.
- The system should log all access attempts to the trainers-only section, with a report generated weekly to monitor unauthorized access attempts.

Test Outline:
- Verify that only users with trainer roles can access the trainers-only section by testing various user accounts.
- Measure the time taken for newly posted content to appear in the trainers-only section after publication.
- Review the access logs weekly to ensure that unauthorized access attempts are being tracked and reported accurately.
